original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

scope_change_reason: Explicit donor request to independently reproduce the existing exact-integer precision backend on Linux, preserving every original check and reporting qualification cost separately; no backend or mathematical construction change.
bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
stop_rule: Stop without retry on source/inventory/mode drift, receipt/witness/control mismatch, stderr or resource failure. Original 180-second per-command limit, 1 GiB sampled process-group RSS, 900 seconds cumulative full local science. Require >=15% lower first-pair wall and CPU before timing expansion; report medians of all original-order six runs. No original timeout/source/expected result repair.
evidence: PROOF-REVIEW.md, COVERAGE.json, BENCHMARK.json, VALIDATION.json and evidence/ retain exact sources, all Linux measurements, full scientific receipts, custody controls and bounded normal/optimized/export qualification.
author: Chris R / Clear1nsight
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for source review, execution, tooling and report; no subagents, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

open_questions.question: Does a second Linux host reproduce the same complete-check gain?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One unreserved host and three observations per arm do not establish a universal speedup.
open_questions.first_step: Authenticate the same head, run full qualification and retain all six B,C,C,B,B,C samples under bounded caps.
open_questions.blocked_by: A separately authorized host measurement, not a kappa experiment.

open_questions.question: Can a changed word use this dyadic backend?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Coverage and common-scale hypotheses are source-specific.
open_questions.first_step: Authenticate the changed word and prove the scale/operation contract before a bounded finite qualification.
open_questions.blocked_by: New source, ownership and coverage gates; no automatic transfer from this audit.
